main_idea: PivotRL training raises Qwen3.5-9B pass@5 on τ³-Banking from 11.3% to 17.5%.
ideas: Training uses teacher distillation and PivotRL.
193 pivots come from 50 solved teacher tasks.
Six general benchmarks show no significant change.
summary: The result is clear, but large method cards, a second statistics row, and repeated footer branding add clutter; nothing essential is missing.
